package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const (
	DialogEventsStream           = "DIALOG_EVENTS"
	DialogRequestConsumerQueue   = "ms-teacher-dialog-requested"
	DialogRequestConsumerDurable = "ms-teacher-dialog-requested-v1"
)

type dialogTeacherRequestedEnvelope struct {
	SchemaVersion        int       `json:"schema_version"`
	EventID              string    `json:"event_id"`
	OccurredAt           time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
	DialogID             string    `json:"dialog_id"`
	EventSequence        int64     `json:"event_sequence"`
	TeacherTurnSequence  *int64    `json:"teacher_turn_sequence"`
	SourceMessageID      string    `json:"source_message_id"`
	SourceSequence       int64     `json:"source_message_sequence"`
	SourceMessageVersion *int      `json:"source_message_version,omitempty"`
	// New producers emit this field explicitly (including null).  It cannot be
	// required by the decoder until previously durable v2 events have drained.
	ReplyToMessageID          *string `json:"reply_to_message_id"`
	CanonicalStudentMessageID *string `json:"canonical_student_message_id"`
	CorrelationID             *string `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID               *string `json:"causation_id"`
	ActionReceiptID           *string `json:"action_receipt_id"`
	StudentCommandID          *string `json:"student_command_id"`
	Channel                   string  `json:"channel"`
	StudentID                 string  `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID         string  `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	ContextType               string  `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID                 *string `json:"context_id"`
	LearningActionID          *string `json:"learning_action_id"`
}

func DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload []byte) (domain.DialogTeacherRequest, error) {
	var envelope dialogTeacherRequestedEnvelope
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("decode dialog teacher request: %w", err)
	}
	// A missing source_message_version is a tolerated old-v2 event. A newly
	// emitted field is a positive integer; JSON null must not silently become a
	// missing value through Go's *int decoding.
	var rawFields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &rawFields); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("decode dialog teacher request fields: %w", err)
	}
	if raw, present := rawFields["source_message_version"]; present &&
		(envelope.SourceMessageVersion == nil || string(raw) == "null" || *envelope.SourceMessageVersion < 1) {
		return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, errors.New("source_message_version must be a positive integer when present")
	}
	if envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV1 && envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV2 {
		return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, errors.New("unsupported dialog teacher request schema version")
	}
	if envelope.SchemaVersion == domain.DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV2 {
		// This is an internal Teacher identity, not Dialog event data. Retain the
		// field in the shared legacy envelope only for V1 compatibility, but make
		// its appearance in V2 a terminal schema violation (including JSON null).
		if _, present := rawFields["student_command_id"]; present {
			return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, errors.New("student_command_id is not part of dialog teacher request v2")
		}
	}
	contextType, err := normalizeDialogContextType(envelope.ContextType)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, err
	}
	return domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		SchemaVersion: envelope.SchemaVersion,
		EventID:       envelope.EventID, DialogID: envelope.DialogID, EventSequence: envelope.EventSequence,
		TeacherTurnSequence: optionalInt64(envelope.TeacherTurnSequence),
		SourceMessageID:     envelope.SourceMessageID, SourceSequence: envelope.SourceSequence,
		SourceMessageVersion: optionalInt(envelope.SourceMessageVersion), ReplyToMessageID: optionalString(envelope.ReplyToMessageID),
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: optionalString(envelope.CanonicalStudentMessageID),
		CorrelationID:             optionalString(envelope.CorrelationID), DialogCausationID: optionalString(envelope.CausationID),
		ActionReceiptID: optionalString(envelope.ActionReceiptID), StudentCommandID: optionalString(envelope.StudentCommandID),
		SourceChannel: domain.DialogMessageChannel(envelope.Channel),
		StudentID:     envelope.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: envelope.PersonalTeacherID,
		ContextType: contextType, ContextID: optionalString(envelope.ContextID),
		LearningActionID: optionalString(envelope.LearningActionID), OccurredAt: envelope.OccurredAt,
	})
}

func optionalInt(value *int) int64 {
	if value == nil {
		return 0
	}
	return int64(*value)
}

func normalizeDialogContextType(value string) (domain.LearningContextType, error) {
	switch value {
	case "general_teacher":
		return domain.LearningContextGeneral, nil
	case string(domain.LearningContextLesson):
		return domain.LearningContextLesson, nil
	case string(domain.LearningContextLessonTask):
		return domain.LearningContextLessonTask, nil
	case string(domain.LearningContextPracticeTask):
		return domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, nil
	case string(domain.LearningContextProject):
		return domain.LearningContextProject, nil
	default:
		return "", domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
}

func optionalString(value *string) string {
	if value == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return *value
}

func optionalInt64(value *int64) int64 {
	if value == nil {
		return 0
	}
	return *value
}

type DialogTeacherRequestedSubscriber struct {
	Conn       *nats.Conn
	Handler    func(context.Context, domain.DialogTeacherRequest) (bool, error)
	Logger     *zap.Logger
	AckWait    time.Duration
	RetryDelay time.Duration
}

func (subscriber DialogTeacherRequestedSubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if subscriber.Conn == nil {
		return errors.New("dialog teacher subscriber connection is required")
	}
	if subscriber.Handler == nil {
		return errors.New("dialog teacher subscriber handler is required")
	}
	logger := subscriber.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = zap.NewNop()
	}
	ackWait := subscriber.AckWait
	if ackWait <= 0 {
		ackWait = 60 * time.Second
	}
	retryDelay := subscriber.RetryDelay
	if retryDelay <= 0 {
		retryDelay = 5 * time.Second
	}
	jetStream, err := subscriber.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = jetStream.QueueSubscribe(
		domain.SubjectDialogTeacherRequested,
		DialogRequestConsumerQueue,
		func(message *nats.Msg) {
			request, decodeErr := DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(message.Data)
			if decodeErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("terminate invalid dialog teacher request", zap.Error(decodeErr))
				if termErr := message.Term(); termErr != nil {
					logger.Warn("terminate dialog teacher request", zap.Error(termErr))
				}
				return
			}
			processed, handleErr := subscriber.Handler(ctx, request)
			if handleErr != nil {
				if errors.Is(handleErr, domain.ErrTeacherDialogRequestConflict) {
					logger.Warn("terminate conflicting dialog teacher request", zap.String("event_id", request.EventID))
					if termErr := message.Term(); termErr != nil {
						logger.Warn("terminate dialog teacher request", zap.String("event_id", request.EventID), zap.Error(termErr))
					}
					return
				}
				logger.Warn("retry dialog teacher request", zap.String("event_id", request.EventID), zap.Error(handleErr))
				if nakErr := message.NakWithDelay(retryDelay); nakErr != nil {
					logger.Warn("nak dialog teacher request", zap.String("event_id", request.EventID), zap.Error(nakErr))
				}
				return
			}
			if ackErr := message.AckSync(); ackErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("ack dialog teacher request", zap.String("event_id", request.EventID), zap.Error(ackErr))
				return
			}
			logger.Debug("dialog teacher request handled", zap.String("event_id", request.EventID), zap.Bool("processed", processed))
		},
		nats.BindStream(DialogEventsStream),
		nats.Durable(DialogRequestConsumerDurable),
		nats.ManualAck(),
		nats.AckExplicit(),
		nats.DeliverAll(),
		nats.AckWait(ackWait),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return subscriber.Conn.FlushTimeout(5 * time.Second)
}
